_about: Phase 1 (manual): the requests I rewrote by hand for the underspecified-per-fact (drop-F) variants of fact_coverage_02's 18 new scenarios, 2026-09-27. Each request removes only the phrase that carries the fact and keeps every other word where grammar allows. Code (kit/policy.py) checks the match set. A fact is not derivable when too few identifying conditions would remain (scope D2) or the check fails.
